notes: Meridian builds search and insights for law firms: contracts, case law, briefs. Sensitive PII and client-confidential docs.
Primary need: semantic retrieval + reranking with strict UK residency for document vectors and logs. Active-active across London (eu-west-2) and Dublin (eu-west-1) to meet latency/DR.
Scale: pilot 5M docs (law firm rollup), production target 30-80M in 12-18 months; architecture must support multi-tenant isolation by client and region.
Performance targets: P95 end-to-end <100ms for single-query searches at 30 qps steady; sustain bursts to 150 qps. Reranker applied to top-8, want reranker P99 <50ms.
Cost focus: finance requests cost-per-query breakdown: embedding lookup cost + reranker cost. Want scenarios for dedicated vs private (on-prem) with quantized cross-encoder options.
Model preference: embedder: open model (LLaMA-embedding variant) on dedicated GPUs; reranker: small cross-encoder (distil/efficient transformer) that can be CPU-offloaded for cheaper tiers.
Indexing: incremental ingestion, per-client sharding, ability to expire or reindex subsets; requires warm KV cache for hot clients to hit <60ms.

Routing & failover: deterministic routing by client billing address -> primary region London; automated failover to Dublin with metadata flags indicating residency constraints. Must ensure no vectors leave UK/EU per client setting.
Security: SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS, full audit trail of queries, retention configurations per client (30/90/365 days). Legal asked for eDiscovery export capability.
Quote from Head of Platform (Mark Gilles): "If P95 creeps above 120ms across our tier-1 clients, we won't renew. Show concrete latency/cost tradeoffs."
They requested Redwood Optimize runbook: batching recommendations, preferred quantization for embedder vs reranker, and caching strategy to reduce reranker calls.
Suggested PoC: 5M doc ingest, compare two reranker placements: hot-GPU for low latency vs CPU-quantized for cost. Measure cost-per-query at 30/60/150 qps.
SE notes: need to validate inter-region replication time and confirm logs are retained in UK/EU-only storage buckets per client flag.

requirements_summary: Data residency: strict UK/EU residency on vectors, logs, and backups; per-client residency flags
Scale: pilot 5M docs, production 30-80M within 12-18 months
Throughput: steady 30 qps, bursts to 150 qps; reranker applied to top-8 results
Latency: P95 E2E target <100ms (goal <80ms) in London/Dublin; Reranker P99 <50ms
Cost: require cost-per-query model; prefer options to trade reranker accuracy vs compute cost (quantized models, CPU fallback)
Routing: deterministic client->region routing + active-active with automated failover; replication must respect residency flags
Security & compliance: SAML SSO, customer KMS, audit logs, retention policies, eDiscovery export
Operations: per-route dashboards, token and model-level cost reporting, alerting on P95 regressions; SOW for on-prem install if needed
